__comment: ADR 0013 S3 registry entry, CONTRACT 2: the same fields as contract 1. What changed is the meaning: a server that writes contract 2 survives --detach from a PyInstaller one-file build (e3746f65), and the hub refuses contract 1 (ppxai/remote/contract.py::RETIRED_CONTRACTS). Changing ppxai/server/registry.py::ENTRY_FIELDS without bumping CONTRACT (and adding a server_registry_contract_<N>.json beside this one) fails tests/test_server_registry.py. Never edit this file for a field change: add the next contract's file.
